prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on the recent price trend: momentum scores 67 of 100 against the comparison pool. Also in its favour: the share price is 2.2% higher than a year ago; over the past year the share did 4.0 percentage points better than the Nifty 50; and the share price is close to its 52-week high. Other areas on this side: growth, the balance sheet, what the price implies.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on price behaviour: the 3-year maximum drawdown was -64.6%, a deep fall. Also against it: one-year volatility is 51.9%, high; growth scores only 7 of 100 against the comparison pool; and quality scores only 24 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: growth, the quality of the business, risk.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 10 points in favour and 6 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 27 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend. That gives an educational rating of Hold with medium confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
